name: Text Match Cut
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: A Flask web application that generates short "match cut" style videos featuring highlighted text. The app centers a specific phrase, surrounds it with related or random text, applies optional blur effects, and allows customization of colors, dimensions, and duration. It can optionally use the Mistral AI API to generate contextually relevant surrounding text.
features: Web-Based Interface: Easy-to-use form built with Flask and HTML.
Custom Highlight Text: Specify the exact phrase you want to highlight.
Configurable Video: Adjust video width, height, duration (seconds), and frames per second (FPS).
Color Customization: Set colors for text, background, and the highlight box using a color picker.
